title: Skateboard deck and press mould
description: An original 8.0 x 31.75 in street deck of seven 1/16 in hard-maple plies with a dyed core, radial concave and 20 degree kicks, cut and drilled from the pressed stack, with the two MDF halves of its press mould.
process: Veneer lamination in a press mould, template cutting and drilling, router round-over; CNC-milled MDF mould

difficulty.rationale: Concentric arc sweeps along a line-and-arc path on a perpendicular datum plane, five laminated bodies cut with keepTool booleans, rail rounds at the kernel's limit, two mould halves from offset sweeps, and closed-form checks of a torus curvature, a section integral and the milling radius, on real deck-making knowledge.

materials: Hard maple veneer, 1/16 in, 12 % moisture (centre core dyed blue)

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: mass 1.2635 kg, volume 109.27 in³, kick 20°, core section and bend curvature as this example's; five bodies 2/1/1/1/2 plies, mould 7/16 in apart; 37 assertions pass at the parameter corners. Milling radius 2.763 in against 2.729: turn 4 left the mould's position open, so turns 1, 2 and 4 now give the origin, centre line and blocks. About 198 steps.
